description: A burst whose bytes hold no D_PDU gives no EOT, so the idle is DCD-determined and LBT_WAIT_TIMER gets lbt_wait_dcd_ms (LBT rule 2).
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047); its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, U_PDU "hello", no confirmation) is data queued for transmission and produces no SIS output (A-0095, K-0096). The received bytes contain no sync (90 EB), so no D_PDU is parsed and no end time is predicted (C-1025). DCD clears at 3000 and is the last to clear, so rule 2 gives 30000 ms (K-0070, K-0073).
